string.text:
A warm field sleeping bag.
Opens the native sleep window
in a safe location.
 
Designed for 5 uses.
A charge is spent only after
sleep is confirmed.

%c[255,170,220,255]Sleeping bag%c[default]
Opens the native Call of Pripyat sleep dialog. It has five uses. A charge is spent only after sleep is confirmed; opening or cancelling the dialog does not spend one. The bag is removed after the fifth sleep.

%c[255,255,190,90]Sleeping pills%c[default]
Open the same sleep dialog and are consumed after one use.
